perspĭcācĭtas , ātis, f. perspicax,
I.sharp-sightedness, discernment, discrimination: “qui nullā perspicacitate, sine innocentium sontiumque differentiā,...damnarunt,” Amm. 15, 3, 2 ; cf.: perspicacitas, τὸ συνοπτικόν, Gloss. Lab.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
